pages.title: Fruits
pages.text: Fruits are sweet, vitamin-rich foods. $(#e05252)Penalty:$() reduced max health when depleted. $(#52c252)Bonus:$() increased regeneration speed when maintained. Apples, melons, and berries all count.

pages.title: Fruits — Croptopia
pages.text: With Croptopia installed, the Fruits group expands significantly. Strawberries, peaches, mangoes, and many more exotic fruits are available to keep this group well-stocked.

pages.title: Fruits — Vanilla
pages.text: Without Croptopia, sweet berries are one of your most accessible wild fruit sources alongside apples and melons. Keep a berry bush farm early on to maintain this group easily.
